# Business Central Instructions Update

Add:

```text
.github/instructions/18-work-plan.instructions.md
```

The instruction applies to:

```text
**/docs/plans/**/*.plan.md
```

Recommended plan folders:

```text
docs/plans/active/
docs/plans/completed/
docs/plans/archived/
```

The instruction standardizes plan status, checklist IDs, traceability, evidence, resume state, change control, and human acceptance. Keep existing instruction files unchanged unless they contain a direct Technical Design to Development flow; replace that route with Implementation Planning.
